I work at the intersection of **corporate finance**, **information economics**, and
**firm dynamics**. My research asks how firms and investors produce, disclose, and act on
information under uncertainty — and how those decisions aggregate into market outcomes.
Recurring threads include the value of information and data, managerial behavior and
cognition, institutional investor engagement, and innovation and corporate networks, studied
with both theoretical models and large-scale text and patent data.
